resources.string: DozyPal counts how many Facebook and Instagram reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts you watch and shows a small counter on screen. It only listens inside those four apps, never reads or saves what is on your screen, and has no internet access.
A sleepy little pal who gets droopier with every reel you scroll.
One step left: turn on DozyPal
DozyPal needs Accessibility access to notice when you swipe to a new reel. Open Accessibility settings, tap DozyPal (it may be under \"Downloaded apps\") and switch it on.
Is the switch greyed out? On Android 13 and newer, open App info, tap the ⋮ menu in the top corner and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
A reel counts after you watch it for 3 seconds. Counts reset automatically every night at 12:00 AM.
Shows a small counter in the corner while you watch reels.
Tip: drag the counter up or down along the edge to move it.
Tell us a little about you so your DozyPal can cheer you on (and tell you when it\'s time to stop).
Your name stays on this phone. It is only used in DozyPal\'s little messages.
Please enter your name (letters only, up to 20 characters).
Add friends with a code and see who scrolled the least today. 🏆
Scroll Battles aren\'t available in this build. Download the latest version from GitHub Releases.
Compete with friends to see who scrolls the least each day. Pick a nickname your friends will see.
Nickname must be 3–20 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, _ . or -

No email or account needed. Only your nickname and today\'s reel counts are shared, and only with friends you add. If you uninstall the app or clear its data, you get a new code and need to add your friends again. You can leave and delete everything at any time.
Couldn\'t join. Check your internet connection and try again.
Friend codes are now shorter! Join again to get your new 5-character code, then share it with your friends.
Whoever scrolled the least today wins 🏆
Add friends with their code to start a battle!
Long-press a friend to remove them. Counts update about every 30 seconds.
That code doesn\'t look right. Codes have 5 letters and numbers.
No one has that code. Check it and try again.
Something went wrong. Check your internet connection and try again.
Tap the code to copy it
Let\'s have a Scroll Battle on DozyPal 😴 Add me with my code: %1$s\nGet the app: https://github.com/nuhanhabib/DozyPal/releases/latest
This deletes your nickname, counts, friend code and friends from the server. Your reel counter keeps working on this phone.

DozyPal only counts swipes inside Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. It never reads messages and never saves what is on your screen. Counting works offline and your history stays on your phone. Only if you join Scroll Battles are your nickname and today\'s counts shared, and only with friends you add.
